name: Mage
source: Talent trees observed in the WoW: Forever BlizzCon demo (2026-09-12), transcribed from demo footage and screenshots; per-talent evidence screenshots are hosted in the media bucket under talents/evidence/. Rank-1 tooltips only; damage, healing and mana numbers are those of the level-38 demo characters (the level-60 BlizzCon slides show higher values). Layout, names and rank counts cross-checked on 2026-09-14 against Wowhead's Forever calculator, talentsforever.com and wowforevertalents.com: identical on all 470 slots. Demo values may change before release.
